info.title: The Buoy API
info.description:
**The Buoy API** — programmatic access to ocean wave buoys on The Surf Kit platform.

All operations are **read-only** (`GET`). Data includes live and historical readings, geographic filters, chart time series, and **`GET /conditions`** (combined forecast, buoy reading, and tide for a point).

## Authentication

Pass your API key in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

`GET /buoys/search` and `GET /buoys/nearest` are public (no key required).

## Rate limiting

Responses include `X-RateLimit-*` headers. Exceeding your hourly quota returns `429 Too Many Requests`.

get.description:
Get a paginated list of buoys with optional filtering by geographic bounds, source, or active status.

Returns buoys in a standardized V2 format with pagination metadata.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Geographic bounding box as JSON string `{"north":44,"south":43,"east":-1,"west":-2}`

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Coordinates and radius in format `lat,lng` (e.g., "43.5,-1.5"). Use with `radius` parameter.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers (used with `near` parameter, default: 100)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source (e.g., "Candhis", "Meteo France", "Sofar Ocean")

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., "FR", "ES", "PT"). When set, up to 500 buoys are returned per page.

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Only return buoys with recent readings (default: true)

count.description: Total number of buoys matching filters

get.description:
Get detailed information about a specific buoy.

The buoy can be identified by ID or slug (friendly ID).

parameters.name: buoy_id
parameters.description: Buoy ID or slug (friendly ID)

get.summary: Get last readings for multiple buoys
get.description:
Bulk fetch the latest reading for a list of buoys by ID.

By default returns the first 3 IDs supplied. Pass `limit` to fetch up to 100 buoys in a single request.

**Tip:** To get last readings for all buoys in a country in one call, use `GET /buoys?country=FR` instead — the index response already includes `last_reading` for each buoy.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated or array-style buoy IDs (e.g., `ids=1,2,3` or `ids[]=1&ids[]=2`)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of buoys to return from the supplied ids list (default: 3, max: 100)

missing_ids.description: IDs that were requested but not found

get.description:
Search for buoys by name, slug, or source identifier.

Returns matching buoys with minimal information.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term (minimum 2 characters)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results (default 10, max 50)

get.description:
Find the closest active buoy(s) to a given latitude and longitude within a maximum distance.

Use the `limit` parameter to control how many results are returned (default: 1, max: 20).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

parameters.name: max_distance
parameters.description: Maximum search radius in kilometers (default: 150)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 1, max: 20)

get.summary: Get historical readings for a buoy
get.description:
Get paginated historical readings for a buoy. Supports filtering by date range.

**Pagination:** Default 20 per page, minimum 1, maximum 100 per page.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by single date (YYYY-MM-DD). Alternative to start_date/end_date.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Filter by unix timestamp (seconds). Returns readings within a 3-hour window.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order

get.summary: Search for reading closest to a specific time
get.description:
Find the reading closest to a target datetime within a tolerance window.

Useful for finding conditions at a specific past time.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Target date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Target time (HH:MM)

parameters.name: tolerance_hours
parameters.description: Hours to search around target time (default: 3, max: 24)

400.description: Missing date or time parameter, or invalid format

404.description: No reading found within tolerance window

get.description:
Returns grouped year-over-year seasonal time series for a single buoy without pagination.

Supports Météo-France and Candhis buoys and is intended for server-side consumers
that need chart-ready seasonal comparison data. Metric availability is source-specific:
Météo-France supports wave, water temperature, and wind metrics; Candhis supports wave
metrics only. For Candhis, `significient_height` maps to H13D (H1/3),
`period` maps to TH13D (significant wave period), and `peak_period` maps
to TP (peak period).

When `start_year` and `end_year` are omitted, the endpoint returns the last 10 complete
seasons. Explicit year ranges can request up to 13 seasons, for example `2013..2025`.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to return for the seasonal series. Candhis supports `significient_height`, `maximum_height`, `period`, `peak_period`, and `direction`.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket size for grouping the seasonal series

parameters.name: aggregation
parameters.description: Aggregation used when bucket is day or week

parameters.name: start_year
parameters.description: Inclusive first season year. Explicit ranges can span up to 13 seasons.

parameters.name: end_year
parameters.description: Inclusive last season year. Explicit ranges can span up to 13 seasons.

parameters.name: season_start_month
parameters.description: Season start month

parameters.name: season_start_day
parameters.description: Season start day of month

parameters.name: season_end_month
parameters.description: Season end month

parameters.name: season_end_day
parameters.description: Season end day of month

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used for bucket boundaries and labels. Defaults to the buoy timezone or UTC.

200.description: Seasonal chart series grouped by year

400.description: Invalid metric, bucket, aggregation, timezone, or season window

422.description: Unsupported buoy source for seasonal series

get.description:
Returns combined forecast, reading, and tide data for a location in a standardized V2 format.

This endpoint combines:
- Wave forecast (height, period, direction, energy)
- Wind forecast (speed, direction)
- Swell forecast (height, period, direction)
- Nearest buoy reading (if available within 50km)
- Tide information (height, direction, next change)

**Improvements over V1:**
- ✅ Standardized `{status, data, meta}` response format
- ✅ Structured JSON data (not human-readable string)
- ✅ Includes nearby buoy/weather station information
- ✅ Better error handling
- ✅ Optional `spot_id` parameter for enhanced context
- ✅ Forecast metadata (update times, sources)

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude in decimal degrees

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude in decimal degrees

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for which to get conditions

parameters.name: spot_id
parameters.description: Optional spot ID for enhanced context and nearby data

forecast.description: Wave, wind, and swell forecast data

wave_energy.description: Wave energy in kJ per meter per wave
Wave energy in kJ per meter per wave

buoy.description: Information about the buoy providing the reading

seconds_to_next_tide_change.description: Seconds until the next tide change (high or low)

next_tide.description: Type of the next tide change

next_tide_height.description: Height of the next tide in meters

harbor.description: Harbor name used for tide calculations

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the data sources

forecast_updated_at.description: When the forecast was last updated

reading_age_minutes.description: Age of the reading in minutes (if reading exists)

forecast_only.summary: Conditions with forecast only (no nearby buoy)

400.description: Missing required parameters (lat, lng, or time) or invalid format

readings_count.description: Total number of readings for this buoy

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination metadata included in list responses

BuoyWithLastReading.description: Buoy with last reading (used in bulk last_readings endpoint)

BuoySearch.description: Minimal buoy information for search results

distance_km.description: Distance from query coordinates in kilometers

complete.description: Whether the requested season is complete for this year

ErrorResponse.description: Standardized error response format for V2 API

details.description: Additional error details (optional, varies by error type)

sample_count.description: Number of raw readings contributing to the bucket

example.message: Search term must be at least 2 characters

Unauthorized.description: Invalid or missing API key (401 Unauthorized)

RateLimitExceeded.description: Rate limit exceeded (429 Too Many Requests)

schema.description: Unix timestamp when rate limit resets (top of next hour)

example.message: You have exceeded 1000 requests per hour

schema.description: Unix timestamp when rate limit resets

ApiKeyAuth.description:
API key authentication. Pass your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

Format: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`

Alternative: Pass as query parameter `?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY`

**Security:** API keys are stored as BCrypt hashes (never plain text). Only the hash is stored in the database.
